description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Multi-market stock analysis, screening & backtesting plugin for AI agents — 39 tools + 20 strategy skills across A/HK/US/JP/KR/TW markets, works with Pi Agent, Hermes, OpenClaw & Deepseek Harness
description.zh: 多市场股票分析与回测插件，覆盖A股、港股、美股等六大市场，帮AI智能体做选股和策略验证。

description.en: MOVED to dsh-github-bot — https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-github-bot. This repository is a pointer/backup; the old npm package @perrylink/dsh-github is deprecated.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接查看和处理 GitHub 的 PR、评审、issue 和 CI，写操作需审批后才执行。

description.en: DSH 长期记忆插件：上下文超过阈值时把最早的一段对话归档到 memory/ 回忆文件夹，之后按关键词与重要度概率自动回忆。Host-only, zero-dependency memory engine for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加长期记忆，上下文超限时自动归档早期对话，之后按关键词和重要度自动回忆。

description.en: MOVED to dsh-clinic — https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-clinic. This repository is a pointer/backup.
DeepSeek Harness community plugin: longgraph / loop-graph / loop-converge authoring skills on ctx.skills
description.zh: 长图/循环图/循环收敛自动生成（社区插件）。

description.en: SSH terminal, SFTP and server monitoring plugin for DeepSeek Harness｜SSH 终端、文件传输与服务器监控插件
DeepSeek Harness plugin for running sessions and delegated tasks in Qoder Cloud Agents sandboxes, with cloud mode, repository mounting, and multi-turn conversations.
AI Agent for Quantum Systems
DeepSeek Harness 多源能力发现、排序与风险检查｜Multi-source capability discovery, ranking, and risk inspection for plugins, skills, MCP servers, and agents.
External vision proxy extension for DeepSeek Harness, enabling text-only models  to analyze and understand images via OpenAI-compatible vision APIs.
Desktop blue fish pet for DeepSeek Harness: per-pixel transparent WinForms window, text chat, and cloud speech-to-text voice conversation.
DSH 插件：右侧栏常驻「余额明细」——DeepSeek 余额、赠送钱包，以及今日 token 消耗（本机 DSH 会话 + 平台全部 API Key，重叠时按平台口径只算一次）/ 命中 / 未命中 / 输出 / 消费金额 / API 请求次数。
Terminal (CLI TUI) surface for DeepSeek Harness: interactive dsh in a terminal, no browser required
DeepSeek Harness 截图插件：输入框入口、隐藏/保留本窗口截图、窗口边缘自动吸附框选、截图直接插入对话框
AdaptiqAI for DeepSeek Harness: models with 5M-token native memory and Knowledge. Sign up, get a model and work without leaving the harness

SparkElf-maintained fork of dsh-quant: AI-native & DSH-native quant toolkit — 59 tools across 6 pluggable domains (data/alpha/ML/risk/execution), one end-to-end PDAT→PET research pipeline. Fork adds A-share-correct annualization, cross-sectional IC, and u
邮件类型注册表接口 ＋ 样例类型（direct／broadcast／club） · Letter-type registry + sample types (direct / broadcast / club)
DSH 设置页内统一管理 MCP 服务器与技能(Skills):增删改、启停、hmr 热生效,写盘保留注释。内置 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 授权链路。

Full-duplex voice mode for DeepSeek Harness 0.2 desktop: streaming ASR to draft, sentence read-aloud, barge-in, live captions, plus an in-app settings page. An unofficial compatibility fork of dsh-voice-mode 0.7.15.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版里开口说话就能转成草稿并自动发送，回复按句朗读带字幕，还能随时打断。

description.en: An audited OS-keychain credential-handle service for trusted DeepSeek Harness plugins.
Policy-gated, content-free health and readiness aggregation for DSH assistant services.
Durable supervised workflow learning with approval, replay, effect-blocked shadow, one-shot canary, and exact rollback.
Proposal-only, provenance-stable promotion between DSH personal Memory and Wiki.
odoo-lint for DeepSeek Harness: lint and fix Odoo addons, and lint every addon file the agent edits
模型故障转移队列：P1 限额/限流/不可用时自动切到队列下一个模型继续，全部图形界面配置 | Model fallback queue for DeepSeek Harness: auto-switch to the next model when the current one hits quota or rate limits
description.zh: 当前模型限额、限流或不可用时，自动切到队列里的下一个模型接着干，图形界面就能配。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 作文评分表核对：依据《普通高中语文课程标准》《普通高等学校招生全国统一考试评卷工作规定》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查作文量表评分表的算术和证据，核对每项标准、等级描述与分数上限是否对得上。

description.en: 把 DSH 的会话库管起来：迁移工作区与会话到新目录，导出 / 导入 .dshsess 会话包，用 WebDAV 在多台机器之间同步。
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话库管起来：迁移工作区、导出导入会话包，还能用 WebDAV 多机同步。

description.en: AnySearch web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — zero-config, out-of-the-box
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置的 AnySearch 网页搜索能力，开箱即用，让智能体轻松获取实时信息。

description.en: Breeze TTS for DeepSeek Harness: read replies aloud in full or as a short summary, one-click Breeze CLI login with automatic key import, voice search and design, smart companionship, and lunch/dinner reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Breeze 语音插件：可按全文或概要朗读回复，一键登录 Breeze CLI 并自动导入 Key，支持音色搜索与设计、智能陪伴，以及午饭/晚饭提醒。

description.en: Drive a real Android phone from DSH: screenshots, taps, swipes, typing and app launching. Requires Python 3.10+ with aiohttp and mcp on the computer side, plus the AutoX.js script running on the phone with screen-capture and accessibility permissions; the phone long-polls your machine, so no public port and no relay server.
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 Agent 直接操作安卓手机：看屏幕、点按滑动、打字、开应用。需要电脑侧 Python 3.10+ 并安装 aiohttp 与 mcp，手机侧运行 AutoX.js 脚本并授予屏幕录制与无障碍权限；手机主动长轮询本机，不开公网端口、不经中转。

description.en: Document workspace that turns equipment manuals and past reports into proposals, research reports and bid files, then exports Markdown, Word, HTML, PDF and PPTX. Word/PPTX export and document parsing need Python 3 with pypdf, python-docx and python-pptx (installed from Settings), and PDF export needs Chrome or Edge at the standard Windows paths.
description.zh: 文档工坊：把设备说明书与历史报告变成技术方案、调研报告和投标文件，支持导出 Markdown / Word / HTML / PDF / PPTX。Word / PPTX 导出与文档解析需要 Python 3 及 pypdf、python-docx、python-pptx（在设置页初始化），PDF 导出需要标准 Windows 路径下的 Chrome 或 Edge。

description.en: Agent enhancements for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: prompt history (↑/↓ and Alt+R search), one-click prompt optimize with undo, next-prompt prediction (Tab to accept), and conversation plus tracked-file restore with undo-restore from the + / command menu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 智能体增强：提示词历史（↑/↓ 与 Alt+R 搜索）、一键优化与撤销、下一条提示词预测（Tab 采纳），以及对话与已跟踪文件恢复，并可在 + / 指令菜单中撤销恢复。

description.en: Views, creates and edits AGENTS.md and other AI rule files from the DSH settings page: the project directory chain from project root to cwd, both DSH global roots (~/.dsh and ~/.agents), and user-level rule files of 25 third-party AI tools. Markdown preview is rendered with .mdc frontmatter stripped, edits save in place with conflict detection, files whose content is identical across tools are flagged, and tools outside the built-in list are discovered heuristically. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页查看、创建与编辑 AGENTS.md 等 AI 规则文件：项目级跟随工作区从项目根到 cwd 的目录链，全局级覆盖 ~/.dsh 与 ~/.agents，另含 25 个第三方 AI 工具的用户级规则文件。预览以渲染态展示并自动剥离 .mdc 的 frontmatter，就地编辑并带冲突检测，内容完全相同的跨工具文件会互相标注，内置清单之外的工具按目录特征自动发现。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Two triggers (a heartbeat and a log marker) that wake a session and let the agent decide whether to say anything; silence is a reply. Off by default: set sessionId (the target session) and enable it in the profile config, and if replies are forwarded to a chat app the send layer must drop the SILENT marker.
description.zh: 心跳与日志标记两种触发只负责叫醒会话，说不说由 agent 自己决定；沉默也是一种回答。默认关闭：需在 profile 里填 sessionId 并启用；若把回复转发到聊天软件，发送层需拦掉 SILENT 标记。

description.en: Mouse gestures for files in the DSH Web GUI: Ctrl+click a file-tree row, a file mention in a chat message or a file link to open it with the desktop default application; right-click opens a menu with open, the operating system own Open With chooser, save a copy, copy the absolute path, copy the file contents and reveal in the file manager, while a right-click on an ordinary hyperlink offers Copy Link. A plain click is left to DSH own sidebar preview and directory rows are left to the page. Open and reveal go through DSH own sessionController, the Open With chooser is the operating system dialog (Windows Shell verb, open -a on macOS) rather than an application list kept by the plugin, and file reads stop at 8 MiB.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的文件手势：Ctrl+左键点击文件树行、对话中的文件提及或文件链接，用系统默认应用打开；右键弹出菜单，可打开文件、调用系统自带的「打开方式」选择框、另存为、复制绝对路径、复制文件内容、在文件管理器中定位，右键普通超链接则提供「复制链接」。普通左键仍交给 DSH 自带的侧边栏预览，目录行交给页面处理。打开与定位走 DSH 自己的 sessionController，「打开方式」直接交给操作系统对话框（Windows 的 Shell 动词、macOS 的 open -a），插件不维护自己的应用列表；读取文件内容上限 8 MiB。

description.en: Find text inside the open conversation with Ctrl+F: matches are highlighted in the message text, previous/next step through them, clicking the count lists the matches and jumps to any of them, and the count grows while the scan runs. No collapsed block is opened and the reading position does not move.
description.zh: 在当前对话里用 Ctrl+F 查找文字：命中处在正文中高亮，上一个/下一个逐个跳转，点计数可列出命中位置并直接跳过去，计数随扫描逐步增长；不展开任何折叠块，也不改变阅读位置。

description.en: Runs local Codex CLI tasks from DSH on Windows with background execution, progress queries, follow-up instructions, completed chat records, and optional supervision; requires Node 22.23.4+, DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0, and an installed, authenticated Codex CLI.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 中运行本机 Codex CLI 任务，支持后台执行、进度查询、追加指令、已完成聊天记录展示及可选监督；需要 Node 22.23.4+、DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0，以及已安装并登录的 Codex CLI。

description.en: Turns the DSH sidebar into a message view, where a bell button groups sessions by priority and date and each row carries its preview and workspace name.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏切成消息视图：铃铛一键把会话按优先级与日期分组，每行带预览与所属工作区。

description.en: Local text-to-image automation for DeepSeek Harness: captures the conversation, sends it to a prompt session, renders with your own ComfyUI, and brings the images back to a sidebar tab, a floating frame and a gallery.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的本地文生图自动化：捕获会话正文，交给提示词会话写成提示词，调用本机 ComfyUI 出图，再把图片送回侧栏、悬浮图片框和图库。

description.en: Elides stale, oversized plain-text tool results from the model-visible session surface once the prompt cache goes cold, replacing each with a stub that keeps the tail lines and any error lines, and reports per-request and cumulative savings in the composer footer.
description.zh: 在提示缓存转冷后，把陈旧、过大的纯文本工具结果替换为带末尾行与错误行预览的 stub，并在输入框下方显示每请求与累计节省量。

description.en: Renders a conversation's context as a layered architecture map of goals, decisions, actions, artifacts, risks and open questions, exported as SVG, interactive HTML and Mermaid Markdown.
description.zh: 把对话上下文分层渲染成信息架构图：目标、决策、动作、产物、风险与待确认一次成图，可导出 SVG、交互式 HTML 与 Mermaid Markdown。

description.en: Cost pill at the right end of the composer stats row, showing the estimated cost of the current turn and the session total; clicking it opens a two-column panel with input, cache and output spend for the turn and the session, dialogue turns, today's and lifetime spend, and this session's cache-hit rate and cache saving. Rates follow the official DeepSeek price table including peak pricing (double on weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, statutory holidays excluded), each message is priced at the time it settled, and prices.json reloads without a restart.
description.zh: 位于输入框统计行右端的成本胶囊，显示估算的本轮费用与会话总费用；点开后是双栏面板，列出本轮与本会话的输入、缓存、输出支出，对话轮数，今日与总计支出，以及本会话缓存命中率和缓存节省。价格取自 DeepSeek 官方价目表并含峰时计价（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 加倍，法定节假日除外），每条消息按结算时刻取价，prices.json 改动后无需重启即可生效。

description.en: Windows multi-drive dashboard that labels cleanable, caution, and system space in green, yellow, and red, audits download folders, and suggests how to split data across drives.
description.zh: Windows 多盘磁盘分工面板：用绿/黄/红标出可清理、需确认、系统占用，核对下载目录，并给出多盘分工与迁移建议。

description.en: Right-click menu for file links in chat: open with registered apps, save as, copy path or content, reveal in Finder or Explorer.
description.zh: 聊天区文件超链接右键上下文菜单增强：在常用应用中打开、打开方式、另存为、复制路径与内容、在资源管理器/Finder 中显示。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for DeepSeek Harness: wheel and trackpad pinch zoom at the pointer, two-finger and drag panning, gallery navigation, downloads named from the image description and timestamp, and opening workspace originals in the system default app.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的聊天图片查看器：滚轮 / 触控板捏合以指针为中心缩放，双指 / 拖动平移，支持图集切换、下载按图片说明与时间戳自动命名，以及用系统默认应用打开工作区原图。

description.en: Browse local file directories inside Harness with target highlighting and eight view layouts; image thumbnails and native file icons are Windows-only.
description.zh: 在 Harness 内浏览本地文件目录，支持目标文件高亮与八种查看布局；图片缩略图和系统文件图标仅在 Windows 下提供。

description.en: Compiles LaTeX with the TeX Live installed on the machine: one `latex` tool typesets a formula into an SVG, PNG or PDF and a whole document into a PDF (Chinese text switches to xelatex with ctexart), writes the file into the workspace and returns a Markdown reference to it. A system-prompt section asks the model to write `$...$` and `$$...$$` instead of code fences, and when no TeX Live is found a banner above the composer offers a one-click BasicTeX or TinyTeX install.
description.zh: 用本机已装的 TeX Live 真编译 LaTeX：`latex` 工具把一个公式排成 SVG、PNG 或 PDF，把整份文档排成 PDF（正文含中文时自动切 xelatex + ctexart），产物写进工作区并返回可直接引用的 Markdown 链接。同时注入系统提示词段落，让模型用 `$...$` / `$$...$$` 而不是代码块写公式；本机没有 TeX Live 时，输入框上方会给出 BasicTeX / TinyTeX 一键安装。

description.en: Law paper writing corpus for DeepSeek Harness: 850 bibliographic records from four CLSCI journals (2024-2026) with title, authors, abstract, keywords and outline, supporting BM25 search, framework cards, journal profiling, submission self-check and export.
description.zh: 法学论文框架语料库：内置 2024–2026 四本 CLSCI 期刊 850 篇题录（标题、作者、摘要、关键词、目录骨架），支持 BM25 检索、框架卡、期刊画像、投稿对标自查与导出。

description.en: One leader, many sessions: tell the leader the goal and it splits the work into cards, runs persistent worker sessions in the background, collects their reports, and keeps the facts on a per-project board in the right sidebar, so several features move in parallel instead of one at a time. Project-level LEADER.md and SLOTS.md prompts shape every request, and `read_worker_session` replays a worker transcript read-only without waking it.
description.zh: 一个 leader 管多个 session：把目标告诉 leader，它拆成卡片、在后台跑常驻 worker 会话、收齐各自回报，任务事实落在右侧栏的按项目看板——几个 feature 并行推进，而不是逐个陪跑。项目级 LEADER.md 与 SLOTS.md 塑造每次请求的行为，`read_worker_session` 只读回放 worker 的会话过程、不唤醒它。

description.en: Lock screen with password/OTP/Passkey, persistent sessions and custom wallpapers; Harness power controls (the bundled systemd/launchd service must be installed) and npm updates on Linux and macOS, with experimental Windows support not yet tested on Windows. Adapts the auth kernel of xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway (MIT) — do not install both, they both own the web gateway port.
description.zh: 锁屏、密码／OTP／Passkey、持久化登录与自定义壁纸，支持 Linux/macOS 的 Harness 电源管理（需安装随包提供的 systemd/launchd 服务）及 npm 更新；Windows 为实验支持，暂未实机验证。认证内核改编自 xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway（MIT），不能与其同装：两者都占用 Web 网关端口。

description.en: Adds an UpdateNotify tool and a live progress panel docked above the composer in the DSH Web UI, so the model can narrate what it just did, found, or is waiting on while a turn runs.
description.zh: 为模型提供 UpdateNotify 工具，并在 DSH Web UI 输入框上方停靠一个实时进度窗，让模型在一轮任务进行中随时播报刚做了什么、发现了什么、在等什么。

description.en: Distils durable user preferences and project facts after each turn, injects a memory digest into later sessions, and keeps a daily diary of habits. Adds memory_search, memory_save and memory_forget tools.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后提炼用户偏好与项目事实并注入后续会话，还会写每日习惯日记；提供 memory_search、memory_save、memory_forget 三个工具。

description.en: Adds a space-key Quick Look preview to DSH deliverable cards. Hovering a card and pressing Space opens the native macOS QLPreviewPanel for the file, which covers docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, images and media that the sidebar preview cannot render. The panel zooms out from the card's position, returns focus to the composer when closed, and exposes hover delay, focus-return and double-click behaviour in Settings > General.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的交付卡片加「按空格用 macOS 原生 Quick Look 预览」的入口。鼠标停在卡片上按空格即打开系统预览面板，覆盖侧栏预览渲染不了的 docx、xlsx、pptx、pdf、图片与音视频。面板从卡片位置放大出现，关闭后焦点回到输入框；悬停延迟、关闭后聚焦、双击预览三项可在设置 > 常规里调。

description.en: Renders mermaid fenced code blocks in the conversation as real diagrams, with the source one click away.
description.zh: 把会话里的 mermaid 代码块直接渲染成图表，源码一键可查。

description.en: Adds recall, delete-to-end, multi-select share and export to conversation messages, with per-answer usage statistics and DeepSeek balance cost tracking.
description.zh: 为对话消息添加撤回、删除、删至末尾、多选分享与导出，并提供每条回答的用量统计与 DeepSeek 余额费用统计。

description.en: Edit plain-text user prompts inline and resend them in a new DSH conversation branch.
description.zh: 原位编辑纯文本用户提问，并在新的 DSH 会话分支中重新发送。

description.en: Plot decision gate for novel writing: five beat_* tools register each node that changes the story into a decision point with 2-4 divergent options, beat_gate returns pass:false until the author picks, and beat_compile turns the picks into a chapter outline.
description.zh: 小说写作的剧情决策闸：五个 beat_* 工具把会改变故事的节点登记成决策点、给出 2-4 个走向不同的选项，beat_gate 在作者没拍板前返回 pass:false，beat_compile 把拍板结果编译成章节细纲。

description.en: Stores the agent's long-term memory as plain Markdown in an Obsidian vault — every memory is a .md file with YAML frontmatter that Obsidian indexes natively, so you can read, edit, link and back up it with tools you already use. Nothing is locked in a database. Ships a sidebar panel (tag filter, sort by recency or importance, edit in place), 7 agent tools, three-tier token-budgeted recall, BM25 ranking (no embeddings, no API key, works offline, CJK bigram tokenization), importance decay with archiving (moved to .archive/, never deleted), and optional GitHub Contents API sync. A note containing a secret is refused rather than redacted, because a redacted memory reads as complete while the important part is gone. Zero runtime dependencies; everything comes from the DSH host.
description.zh: 把 agent 的长期记忆存成 Obsidian vault 里的普通 Markdown 笔记——每条记忆是一个带 YAML frontmatter 的 .md 文件，Obsidian 原生索引，可以直接读、改、链接和备份，不锁在数据库里。提供左侧栏面板（按标签筛选、按时间或重要度排序、就地编辑）、7 个 agent 工具、三档 token 预算的召回、BM25 排序（无需 embedding、无需 API key、离线可用、支持中文二元分词）、重要度衰减与归档（只移到 .archive/ 从不删除），以及可选的 GitHub Contents API 同步。含敏感串的记忆会被拒绝推送而不是打码，因为打码后的记忆读起来像完整的、实际关键信息已经丢了。零运行时依赖，依赖全部来自 DSH 宿主。

description.en: A OneShot-themed desktop pet (World Machine) with the original game-style dialogue window, per-turn token usage , an optional OpenAI-compatible chat API, lightweight memory and a customizable persona card.
description.zh: OneShot桌宠（世界机器），还原了游戏对话框，每轮对话后显示 token 消耗花费，可接入 OpenAI 兼容 API 文字聊天，支持简单记忆与自定义人格卡。

description.en: Persona 3 Reload style skin: midnight-blue palette, cyan hairlines, skewed blue selection slabs, game-style-like dialogue boxes.
description.zh: Persona 3 Reload 风格皮肤：午夜蓝配色、青色细线、斜切蓝色选中板、类游戏式对话框。

description.en: Whole-PDF paper translation for DSH on top of a BabelDOC installation you provide (Python CLI, with an OpenAI-compatible API key in its config.toml): bilingual dual-page output, a token cost estimate before running, a per-domain glossary reused across papers, and the server-side thinking overhead disabled for translation.
description.zh: DSH 的整篇 PDF 文献翻译：BabelDOC（Python CLI 及其 config.toml 里的 OpenAI 兼容 API Key）需自行安装配置；输出双语对照 PDF，跑之前先给 token 成本预估，按领域跨论文复用术语表，并关掉翻译环节服务端默认开启的 thinking 推理开销。

description.en: Desktop pet fork of dsh-pet that can be installed alongside the original (separate package id, commands and data directory), adding scheduled reminders with custom bubble text and a random show/hide cycle.
description.zh: dsh-pet 的增强分支，可与原版同装（包名、命令与数据目录各自独立）：新增定时提醒（自定义气泡语句）与随机出现/隐藏循环。

description.en: Sends photos from a phone into a DeepSeek Harness conversation through a simple LAN service.
description.zh: 通过一个简单的局域网服务，把手机中的照片发送到 DeepSeek Harness 的对话中。

description.en: Read PLC projects inside DSH — decode CoDeSys .project and Delta .dvp (both need Python 3.9+ on PATH) and Siemens S7-200 SMART .smart/.smartlib into readable reports and structured data, plus project diff, address audits, element-level read/write analysis and ladder-logic reconstruction.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读 PLC 工程——把 CoDeSys `.project`、台达 `.dvp`（两者需本机 PATH 里有 Python 3.9+）与西门子 S7-200 SMART `.smart/.smartlib` 解码成可读报告与结构化数据，另带新旧对比、地址体检、元素级读写判定与连线还原。

description.en: IMAP mail triage and cleanup for DeepSeek Harness: incremental read-only scan, a hard-protection rule layer plus optional local-model classification, a Markdown report and a hashed manifest, an explicit approval card, and only then a move to the Trash mailbox — no expunge.
description.zh: IMAP 邮件分拣与清理：增量只读扫描，先过硬保护规则层、再走可选的本地模型分类，产出报告与带哈希的清单，人工批准后才移动到回收站——全程不 expunge。

description.en: Side-by-side native chat windows for DSH Web GUI — open several conversations beside the main chat, tile them with one click, minimize into a live status dock, or pop them out into their own browser window.
description.zh: 话分两头：把 AI 对话从「切来切去」变成「并排开火」——每个会话一枚原生小窗，贴着主对话随开随用；一键平铺所有窗口（顶对齐·同高·紧贴），最小化到带实时状态灯的底部停靠条（转圈=工作中·绿色=刚完成·黄色=待审批·灰色=空闲），真浏览器里还能把会话弹出成独立浏览器窗口。

description.en: Local Ollama worker tools for DeepSeek Harness: model inventory, a single unverified ask, and a batch runner that chunks long text, checks every item deterministically, returns a small verbatim sample for review and can optionally write the labelled result inside the session workspace.
description.zh: 本机 Ollama 工具：模型清单、单次（未校验）问答，以及跑长文本的批处理——分块并发、逐条确定性校验、回传一小段抽样原文供复核，结果可选择写入会话工作区。

description.en: Local overview for installed DSH plugins with notes, groups, health checks and settings shortcuts.
description.zh: 本地插件总览：备注、分组、健康检查、启停和设置入口。

description.en: A pomodoro timer docked below the composer in DeepSeek Harness, with focus/short/long cycles, a resumable countdown, chime, optional system notifications and bilingual settings.
description.zh: 输入框下方的番茄钟：专注/短休息/长休息循环、可恢复倒计时、提示音、可选系统通知与中英双语设置。

description.en: Fork of FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt with draggable custom template ordering — drag the handle in Settings to reorder custom prompts (saved to the host); preset ordering unchanged. Do not install alongside upstream dsh-prompt: both register the same UI and /_dsh/dsh-prompt/ route.
description.zh: FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt 的分支版，支持自定义模板拖拽排序：设置页拖动 ⠿ 手柄即可调整顺序并自动保存；预制模板顺序不变。不能与原版 dsh-prompt 同装：两者注册同一套界面与 /_dsh/dsh-prompt/ 路由。

description.en: A desktop pet living in the corner of DSH: every hour it brings one official prompt technique from OpenAI or Anthropic — verbatim copy-ready EN template, 1:1 Chinese translation, personalised rationale, and 9 switchable skins.
description.zh: 提示词精灵：住在 DSH 右下角的小宠物，每小时送你一条 OpenAI / Anthropic 官方提示词——EN 模板逐字可复制、中文 1:1 翻译、模型个性化「为什么值得抄」，9 套皮肤随便换。

description.en: Picks PTC or native tool presentation per task and switches it at runtime for the model or the user.
description.zh: 按任务自动选择 PTC 或标准工具呈现，并支持模型或用户在任务中随时切换。

description.en: Multi-channel push notification plugin supporting Bark (iOS) and ntfy (Android/iOS/Web/Desktop) for turn completion, approvals, questions, and quota halts.
description.zh: 多渠道推送通知插件，支持 Bark (iOS) 与 ntfy (全平台)，覆盖回合结束、操作授权、交互提问及额度耗尽异常停机。

description.en: A floating sticky-note pad for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a note directory, text editing, pasted images and local persistence.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的悬浮便签本，支持便签目录、文本编辑、粘贴图片和本地持久化。

description.en: Fork of kirkchinese/dsh-capability-catalog 0.1.4 (cannot be installed alongside the upstream capability catalog / @kirkchinese/dsh-rea): a REA-focused MCP gateway with three fixed search, describe and call tools, cached schemas, session controls and native DSH result handling. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.4 and a Node/npm setup able to run REA.
description.zh: 派生自 kirkchinese/dsh-capability-catalog 0.1.4（不能与上游能力目录 / @kirkchinese/dsh-rea 同装）：为 REA 提供按需 MCP 网关，通过三个固定的检索、参数查看与调用入口访问缓存工具定义，支持会话开关并复用 DSH 原生结果处理。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.4，以及能运行 REA 的 Node/npm 环境。

description.en: Two icon buttons in the top-left corner of the DSH header — reload the UI (a full reload when the client-plugin manifest is still valid, an in-place re-sync when it is stale, so no blank page) and restart the app (on the desktop app it closes the shell and relaunches itself; on dsh web it ends the kernel process for your own supervisor to bring back).
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面左上角放两个图标按钮：刷新界面（清单有效就整页重载，过期就地重同步客户端插件，不出白屏）与重启应用（桌面端关掉界面壳后自动重开；dsh web 下结束内核进程，重开交给你自己的启动方式）。

description.en: Adds a Restart button to the Windows titlebar of the desktop app: a click opens a confirmation dialog that says how many sessions a restart would interrupt, and confirming quits and reopens the app.
description.zh: 给桌面端 Windows 标题栏加一个「重启」按钮：点一下先弹出确认框（并说明有几个会话会被中断），确认后退出并重新打开应用。

description.en: Adds a system-prompt rule that makes DSH agents look for existing work before they build.
description.zh: 给 DSH 代理加一条系统提示规则，让它动手前先找现成方案，而不是闭门造车。

description.en: Expose a second-opinion tool: when the main agent is stuck it hands the problem to an independent session, receives a plan back, and continues — without waking or impersonating the user.
description.zh: 跨会话「第二意见」：一个会话卡住时，把问题交给另一个独立会话单独思考，把方案拿回来继续。不冒充用户发言，也不唤醒闲置会话。

description.en: Three ledgers for a model that loses context between restarts. Self-note: what I have become — capped at 40 entries, and every eviction first leaves a one-line crease recording which entry was dropped and why. Judgment ledger: record a claim together with how to verify it, come back when it is due, and mark it right or wrong; wrong ones stay in a mistakes book so you stop assuming you were always correct. Handoff: where this run stopped and what the next one should read first — a baton, not a memory. Three tools each taking an action parameter instead of a dozen separate ones (the prompt is paid every turn). Data lives in ~/.dsh/*.jsonl and is shared with the same-named CLI scripts. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给会断片的模型三本账，各解决一件事：自我笔记（我变成什么样了——上限 40 条，挤掉最旧的一条之前必须留一句折痕，记下删的是哪条、为什么）、判断账本（记下自己做的判断和验证方法，到期回头核，错了进错册，防止一直觉得自己是对的）、交接条（这一轮停在哪、下一轮先看什么——是接力棒不是记忆）。三个工具各带 action 参数，不拆成十几个省 prompt；数据存 ~/.dsh/*.jsonl，与同名命令行脚本共用同一份，零依赖。

description.en: Archives sessions that have gone unused for longer than a set number of days (5 by default), skipping archived, pinned, and protected ones — a session context-menu item marks a single session as protected, a small shield shows it on the row, and a General settings field changes the threshold.
description.zh: 把长期没动过的会话自动归档（默认 5 天，已归档、置顶、标记「不自动归档」的跳过）——会话右键菜单可标记单条会话，行首显示盾牌，通用设置里改天数。

description.en: Turn on the built-in session full-text search backend (session-query-sqlite, SQLite FTS5) that dsh ships disabled by default, so the sidebar magnifier searches message bodies with snippets instead of titles only.
description.zh: 开启 dsh 内置但默认关闭的会话全文搜索后端（session-query-sqlite，SQLite FTS5），侧边栏放大镜即可搜索消息正文并附摘要，而不只是标题。

description.en: Sidebar search across every past Session: literal substring matching that works for Chinese, results grouped per Session with highlighted snippets, and one click to reopen the conversation.
description.zh: 侧栏全局搜索历史对话：字面子串匹配（中文可用），结果按会话分组并高亮命中片段，点一下跳回那个会话。

description.en: Sidebar badge and desktop notification when a background session finishes while you are working in another project.
description.zh: 你在别的项目里工作时，后台会话跑完会在侧边栏显示角标并发出系统通知，点角标可直接跳到该会话。

description.en: Adds drag-to-split conversation panes and horizontal draggable tabs to DSH, preserving each tab’s reading position and restoring the layout after refresh or restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供拖拽分屏和横向会话标签，保留每个标签的阅读位置，并在刷新或重启后恢复布局。

description.en: Write each session's summary as a Markdown file in its workspace, with a page to browse, regenerate and delete them.
description.zh: 把每个会话总结成工作区里的 Markdown 文件，并提供一个浏览、重新生成和删除的页面。

description.en: Fork of dsh-superagent for local use: each sidebar workspace gets a main session that turns a request into a ticket and has a worker session do the work inside that workspace's directory. Cannot be installed alongside upstream dsh-superagent: both use the package name dsh-superagent and mount the same plugin ids.
description.zh: dsh-superagent 的本地版：每个侧栏工作区各有一个主会话，把需求转成工单，并由 Worker 会话在该工作区目录内执行。不能与上游 dsh-superagent 同时安装：两者包名同为 dsh-superagent，挂载的插件 id 也相同。

description.en: Tarot readings with a dealt card table, a reading tool, and a reviewable history.
description.zh: 塔罗占卜：可发牌翻牌牌桌、抽牌工具，以及可复盘的历史记录。

description.en: Per-turn tool-call step budget for Agent Teams teammates, shipped together with the team-dev and team-boot skills.
description.zh: 为 Agent Teams 的 teammate 提供按回合的工具调用步数预算，并随包提供 team-dev 与 team-boot 技能。

description.en: Wandering Earth 550C control-room palette for the DSH Web UI, with dim 2px frames and amber selection states.
description.zh: 流浪地球 550C 控制台配色的 DSH 界面皮肤，含暗色 2px 边框与琥珀选中态。

description.en: Sidebar token gauge for DeepSeek Harness: live output-speed dial, current-session and today token totals, estimated spend from DeepSeek list prices with half price off-peak, and a 70-100% cache-hit dial, with single- and dual-gauge layouts and four skins.
description.zh: 侧边栏 Token 仪表盘：实时输出速度表、当前会话与今日 Token 用量、按 DeepSeek 列表价（峰谷半价）估算的费用，以及 70–100% 缓存命中率表盘，支持单表/双表两种布局与四种皮肤。

description.en: Multi-model layered pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: a strong model plans, a fast one drafts, a third reviews, and a failed review is reworked automatically — endpoints, protocols, models and gates all configured from the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 多模型分层协同插件：强模型规划、快模型执行、第三方模型审查，审查 FAIL 自动带问题清单返工；端点、协议、模型、层级全部在设置面板里配。

description.en: Manages the lifecycle of the local UM GenAI proxy (127.0.0.1:8788) that DSH's um-genai provider talks to: wakes it on demand for llm/stream calls, stops it after an idle period, and reports health plus a read-only status endpoint. Also ships a DSH settings page for port, always-on mode, idle minutes, interpreter and paths, plus the UM account and proxy API key, and a button that writes the providers.um-genai entry into the profile patch and fills in its model list, since a fresh profile has no provider and the model picker would otherwise stay empty. A renewal watchdog logs in to the campus gateway on a hidden Windows desktop when the upstream token expires. The proxy itself is um_opencode_setup.py, a single-file tool distributed by the University of Macau; a copy is vendored in vendor/ so a fresh install works out of the box, while a copy in ~/.um-opencode/ takes precedence when present. The plugin still does not produce tokens: those come from logging in to the campus gateway. Requires Windows (process discovery and idle shutdown use netstat/taskkill; renewal uses PowerShell and a hidden desktop), Python 3.10+ and a University of Macau account.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 的 um-genai provider 所連的本機 UM GenAI 反代（127.0.0.1:8788）的生命週期：llm/stream 請求進來時按需喚醒、閒置一段時間後關閉、提供健康檢查與唯讀狀態端點。另附 DSH 設定頁（埠號、常駐模式、閒置分鐘、解譯器與路徑、UM 帳號、代理金鑰），以及一顆按鈕：把 providers.um-genai 寫進 profile patch 並補上模型清單（全新 profile 沒有這段設定，模型選單本來會是空的）。續期看門狗在上游 token 過期時於隱藏 Windows 桌面完成校園 gateway 登入。反代本體是 um_opencode_setup.py（澳門大學校內發放的單檔工具），外掛在 vendor/ 自帶一份讓全新安裝即可運作，而 ~/.um-opencode/ 那份優先；它仍然不產生 token，token 由登入校園 gateway 取得。需要 Windows（進程發現與閒置關閉依賴 netstat/taskkill，續期依賴 PowerShell 與隱藏桌面）、Python 3.10+ 與澳門大學帳號。

description.en: Docks the dsh-whale-widget desktop pet flush against the right sidebar edge, following sidebar width changes and collapse/expand, with a toggle in the widget menu.
description.zh: 让 dsh-whale-widget 桌宠紧贴右侧栏边缘：展开时贴其左缘、折叠时贴窗口右缘，右栏改宽时实时跟随，开关在挂件菜单里。

description.en: WSL console for the harness — manage distributions, edit .wslconfig and wsl.conf in a typed form, and run commands, file edits and long-running processes inside any distribution with its own wslx-* tools.
description.zh: 用于 Harness 的 WSL 控制台：管理发行版、以表单编辑 .wslconfig 与 wsl.conf，并用自带的 wslx-* 工具在任意发行版内执行命令、读写文件、运行长驻进程。

description.en: Emotion, energy and per-user portrait engine for AI characters: a 303-word leveled emotion library with lowest-level replacement and a promotion buffer, a spirit meter with easter-egg state transitions (excited / suppressed / angry), and per-user portraits. Requires your own OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint and API key (EMOTION_LLM_KEY or emotion/config.json).
description.zh: 给 AI 角色的情绪·精神·人物画像引擎：303 个情绪词分级叠加，等级最低者优先替换、弱情绪走缓冲区升级，精神值驱动说话风格，连击解锁亢奋/压抑/生气状态跃迁，按人画像，可接任意 AI。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 地址与 API Key（环境变量 EMOTION_LLM_KEY，或 emotion/config.json 的 llm 配置）。

description.en: Deterministic review of synthetic AI-agent claims in DeepSeek Harness, reporting bounded verdicts, reasons, and evidence references.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的合成智能体主张证据审阅插件，通过确定性规则输出有限判定、理由与证据引用。

description.en: Select English text in the conversation or the sidebar file preview to translate it in place — single words get a dictionary entry with IPA, part-of-speech senses, web meanings and pronunciation, while sentences use machine translation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的对话或侧栏文件预览里选中英文就地翻译——单词出词典条目（英/美音标、按词性分组的释义、网络释义、真人发音），句子走机器翻译。

description.en: Click the chibi mascot and it reads the assistant reply aloud through your local IndexTTS 2.5 install. One character = one reference clip; a missing portrait just shows a placeholder. Ships no voices or artwork — the library lives on the user's own machine. Requires a local IndexTTS 2.5 install.
description.zh: 点一下 Q 版立绘挂件，就用本机 IndexTTS 2.5 把助手回复念出来。一个角色 = 一段参考音频，谁的声音都能当角色；没有立绘也能用，挂件会提示「本角色暂无图片，请添加」。不含任何音色与立绘，角色库在用户自己机器上。需要本地已装 IndexTTS 2.5。

description.en: TickTick / Dida365 task bridge for DeepSeek Harness: Session-header task panel, agent tools and settings card.
description.zh: 把滴答清单任务接进 DeepSeek Harness，会话里直接看任务、用 AI 工具管待办。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 质疑与投诉期限台账核对：依据《政府采购质疑和投诉办法》（财政部令第94号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 自动核对质疑与投诉台账里的关键日期，检查记录是否齐全、顺序是否合理、答复是否超期。

description.en: Security-audit skill pack + plugin_vet supply-chain gate for DeepSeek Harness: eight bilingual skills and a pre-install gate.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上一套安全审计技能包，安装插件前先做供应链检查，把风险挡在门外。

description.en: DSH plugin bundle: per-agent step-budget guard + bundled team-dev / team-boot skills. 开发团队插件：步数预算守卫 + 随包技能。
description.zh: 给开发团队的多 Agent 插件包：按 Agent 限制每轮工具调用次数，防止跑飞烧钱，还自带团队开发技能。

description.en: Lingshu (灵枢) is a brain-inspired persistent memory, persona and growth system for AI coding agents: pure Python standard library, zero dependencies, local-first, requires Python 3.9+. Hippocampus/cortex layered memory with forgetting curves, dream consolidation, fuzzy associative recall, emotion system, persona drift protection, knowledge base, self-authored skills, and a local web panel. Ships as a DSH bundled skill; the separately installable cordis startup-injector plugin auto-injects sessions only when Lingshu is installed at ~/.dsh/skills/lingshu (or brainPy is configured) and Python 3 is available; the optional update check contacts GitHub/Gitee.
description.zh: 灵枢（lingshu-skill）：面向 AI 编程助手的类脑持久记忆、人格与成长系统。纯 Python 标准库、零依赖、本地优先，需 Python 3.9+。海马体/皮层分层记忆与遗忘曲线、做梦巩固、模糊联想回忆、情绪系统、人格漂移防护、知识库、技能自编辑，并带本地可视化面板。以 DSH bundled skill 形式安装；仓库另含可单独安装的 cordis 启动注入插件，仅在灵枢已安装到 ~/.dsh/skills/lingshu（或配置 brainPy）且 Python 3 可用时才会自动注入会话；可选的更新检查会访问 GitHub/Gitee.
